THE CHALLENGE

Independent and boutique hotels compete with large booking platforms for attention. Guests often struggle to compare rooms, check availability and reach the hotel, while staff spend time on repeat questions across calls, messages and email.

THE APPROACH

This concept designs one connected guest experience: clear room discovery, a short path to booking, restaurant reservations and ordering, and an assistant for common questions, with a dashboard where guests and staff can see what’s happening.

INDUSTRYHospitality
PLATFORMResponsive web + mobile
SERVICESUX/UI, Web Development, Automation, AI Integration
TECHNOLOGYReact, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL
PROJECT TYPEConcept Project

Sarai Suites is a fictional brand created by TexorLab for this concept. It is not a client.

THE PROBLEM

A guest shouldn’t have to call to learn what the hotel could have shown them.

  1. 01Guests compare many hotels and leave before booking direct.
  2. 02Room details and availability are hard to understand quickly.
  3. 03Restaurant tables and food orders run through separate calls and messages.
  4. 04Guest questions arrive at all hours and wait for staff.
  5. 05Staff lack one view of bookings, requests and guest information.

These are product-design assumptions for the concept, not findings from a real hotel.

DESIGN DECISIONS

Pretty Wasn’tthe Goal.

DECISIONREASONRESULTING UX BENEFIT
DECISIONBooking bar on the first screen
REASON

Guests arrive with dates already in mind.

UX BENEFIT

A shorter path from landing to available rooms.

DECISIONRooms compared side by side
REASON

Choosing between rooms is the hardest part of booking.

UX BENEFIT

Easier to choose with confidence.

DECISIONOne account for stays, tables and orders
REASON

Guests use several hotel services during one visit.

UX BENEFIT

One place to manage everything.

DECISIONAssistant with staff handover
REASON

Questions come at all hours, but exceptions need people.

UX BENEFIT

Quick answers to common questions, human help for the rest.

DECISIONLarge touch targets and clear contrast
REASON

Many guests book on phones, in different conditions.

UX BENEFIT

Easier to use on small screens.
